title: XTRA-POWER Heat Gun, (XPT-523) 2000W
description: Transform your DIY projects with the XTRA-POWER Heat Gun, a versatile 2000-watt powerhouse designed for precision and control. This robust tool features dual temperature settings ranging from 80-600°C, allowing you to tackle various applications with ease. The first setting operates at 80-350°C with a 300 L/min airflow, perfect for delicate work, while the second setting reaches 80-600°C with increased airflow of 500 L/min for more demanding tasks. The corded electric heat gun operates on 220V/50Hz power supply, ensuring consistent performance. Its ergonomic red and black design offers comfortable handling during extended use. Whether you're removing paint, shrinking wire wraps, or working on craft projects, this heat gun delivers reliable performance. The double insulation feature provides added safety during operation. This professional-grade tool is essential for both DIY enthusiasts and skilled craftsmen who need precise temperature control for their projects.
